bake.description: Dry heat cooking typically done in an oven; can be adapted via covered heavy pan on low heat or microwave convection.

boil.description: Submerging food in heated water or broth.

fry.description: Cooking food in hot oil or fat.

deep_fry.description: Submerging food entirely in boiling oil; can be substituted with shallow-pan frying.

saute.description: Cooking food rapidly in a small amount of oil over direct heat.

grill.description: Dry radiant heat with char marks; simulated by cast iron or high-heat pan searing.

roast.description: Dry heat roasting; can be approximated by slow dry-pan roasting or air-fryer.

steam.description: Cooking with steam vapor; approximated with a bowl/plate inverted over boiling water in a covered pot.

pressure_cook.description: High pressure sealed cooking; can be substituted with extended slow simmering in a covered pot.

blend.description: Liquefying or pureeing; can be substituted by fork mashing or grinding.

toast.description: Browning surfaces using radiant heat; easily replicated on a dry hot pan.

drain.description: Separating solids from boiling liquids; can be performed using pot lid cracked open.
